name: Patel Integrated Logistics Ltd
title: Patel Integrated Logistics Ltd-$ - 526381 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 profit rose on margin and cost control, but the call gave no capacity, utilisation or inventory data; management leaned on promotional claims and a Rajpat subsidiary with no numbers beyond an unsupported 25% revenue add.

triggers.label: International rates up 15% since March
triggers.quote: As I'm talking to you from March, 15%, international rates have increased. So, rates are hardening.

triggers.label: Valuation rerating claim without guidance
triggers.quote: we are expecting very soon the company will have a valuation rerating

guidance.value: adds another 25% to the ~INR400 crore base
guidance.quote: Rajpat will add another 25% from that.
we are expecting a upward of 15% in return on capital employed from that business

red_flags.label: Dividend 30% of PAT on tiny cash base; DSO/ROCE claims unquantified
red_flags.quote: It is basically 30% of our profit after tax

red_flags.label: Non-core property redevelopment, no numbers
red_flags.quote: we are actively pursuing for the redevelopment

evasions.quote: it is very difficult to tell right now
right now immediately we are not looking
